capabilities: Extract entities and concepts from notes, PDFs, images and Office files into linked wiki pages
Answer questions over the wiki in a side-panel chat with citations and wiki links
Batch-ingest a folder or a selected set of files
Lint the wiki for duplicates, dead links, empty pages, orphans and contradictions
Repair wiki issues in one step with Smart Fix All
extras: Free and donation-supported. Detailed setup guides live outside the README (docs/MODEL-GUIDE.md, docs/PDF-OCR-GUIDE.md). Privacy caveat: the optional MinerU backend uploads documents to mineru.net, a service that publishes no retention statement. The plugin itself never modifies source notes and writes only under wiki/.
intentEvidence: Other open-source reimplementations of Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea exist — but none ships as a one-click Obsidian plugin.
motivation: The author wanted an implementation of Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea that runs as a one-click Obsidian plugin, since other open-source versions were CLI tools, coding-agent skills, or separate desktop apps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to have an LLM build a cross-linked wiki from your notes and answer questions grounded in them with citations.

relations.evidence: Other open-source reimplementations of Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea exist — but none ships as a one-click Obsidian plugin.
The plugin writes standard frontmatter (tags:, type:, aliases:) on every page, so Dataview queries work out of the box.
Obsidian Web Clipper — official browser extension.

requires.name: Ollama or LM Studio for local models; MinerU token for document conversion

summary: LLM-powered wiki generator that extracts entities and concepts from notes, PDFs and Office files into interlinked pages, then answers questions over that link graph.
